option_description: The OS-family discriminator (linux/macos/bsd/windows) that selects which OS-specific hardening attestations are evaluated for this host.
security_impact: Not itself an exposure trigger — it GATES the OS-specific facets of three exposures: "Local privilege escalation to root/SYSTEM", "Kernel-isolation bypass enabler (MAC not enforcing / unprivileged userns)", and "On-host credential / secret exposure". Linux evaluates SELinux/AppArmor + user-namespaces + sudo/setuid + shadow-file perms; Windows evaluates UAC + LSASS; macOS/BSD evaluate the Unix arm (sudo/setuid/credential-file perms). Setting it correctly is what prevents a Linux host being false-flagged by Windows controls and vice-versa.
